scope: Reconcile current open-source DWG/DXF and ACIS peer capability claims by exact route and evidence layer; refine the existing optional composed validation checkpoint.

sources.name: LibreDWG current manual
observations: The manual describes broad read/mostly-write coverage as ongoing.
It states that R2007 DWG writing is not implemented.
It lists enabled entity/object classes that remain unstable or undertested.
sources.limit: Project documentation is a capability disclosure, not an independent runtime qualification for every revision or object family.

sources.name: LibreDWG repository README and NEWS
observations: The README warns that R2010-R2018 writing still leads to CRC errors.
NEWS distinguishes historical AcDsPrototype_1b limitations from later decoder work.
sources.limit: Do not merge historical notes with current release behavior or transfer peer reports to libdxfrw.

sources.name: ezdxf 1.4.5 documentation
observations: The documented support contract includes ASCII and Binary DXF read/write for named target versions.
The normal loader and the repair/recovery path are separate; recovery repairs ASCII DXF and audits the result.
sources.limit: No ezdxf package was installed or run during this research pass. Recovery/audit cannot qualify strict read or preservation.

sources.name: ezdxf ACIS API and FAQ
observations: The API exposes SAT/SAB load/export operations, but the FAQ says only SAT can be written; the documentation conflict remains unresolved by an exact-version execution.
Unsupported ACIS structures may be represented as NONE_ENTITY and lose data.
Mesh extraction covers flat polygonal faces and does not provide an ACIS kernel; payload authoring requires an external library.
sources.limit: Do not treat an API signature, parser result, or flat mesh as arbitrary ACIS roundtrip or B-rep validity evidence.

sources.name: ezdxf drawing renderer documentation
observations: 3D entities are projected into the XY plane because the renderer has no 3D rendering engine.
sources.limit: Renderer output is not 3D geometry or topology evidence.

sources.name: ACadSharp v3.7.1 and open schema-value report
observations: The released structured Prototype_1b reader is a candidate DWG structure comparator.
An open PR reports a multi-valued schema property parsing defect; ODA specification section 24 remains the byte-layout authority.
sources.limit: No ACadSharp runtime was run; its high-level schema lookup is not accepted as the primary row/index/owner ledger.

sources.name: CADMPEG, acis-core, cq-acis, and FreeCAD routes
observations: Payload parser/profile support, selected shape construction, and native DXF import are distinct stages.
Shared format-discovery or geometry-kernel lineage means tool agreement is not automatically independent evidence.
Stock FreeCAD DXF import is not a general ACIS semantic route.
sources.limit: No external runtime, native application, or downloaded drawing was used.

plan_changes: Clarify route selection for the optional composed checkpoint: normal DXF parser, recovery/audit, carrier extraction, ACIS parser, geometry construction, renderer, and native application are separate evidence cells.
Require exact artifact/runtime/build/input/profile binding and explicit unsupported/ignored-record disposition for any peer result.
Keep local generated fast tests as the per-slice loop; external peer and native gates remain optional, non-blocking, and outside routine per-slice validation.
Do not infer B-rep, preservation, modern DWG writer, or native application support from parser breadth, recovered output, rendering, or same-codec readback.
not_done: No source or implementation code changed.
No peer dependency/runtime was installed or executed.
No external DWG, DXF, SAT, or SAB fixture was downloaded or committed.
No new finding, top-level subplan, test, or support claim was added.
